schema.text: Why don't you use public transport, or why do you use it so rarely? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: We ask this to understand what limits the use of public transport for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: The stop is too far away or hard to reach
Poor service in the evening or at night
Stops or vehicles are not accessible with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
I don't feel safe at stops or on board
Trips take too long or need too many changes
I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

it.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Perché non usi il trasporto pubblico, o perché lo usi così poco? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita l'uso del trasporto pubblico per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: La fermata è troppo lontana o difficile da raggiungere
it.#Services are infrequent or unreliable: Le corse sono poco frequenti o inaffidabili
it.#Poor service in the evening or at night: Il servizio è scarso di sera o di notte
it.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Fermate o mezzi non accessibili con sedia a rotelle, deambulatore o passeggino
it.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Non mi sento al sicuro alle fermate o a bordo
it.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Gli spostamenti richiedono troppo tempo o troppi cambi
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me

fr.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Pourquoi n'utilisez-vous pas les transports en commun, ou pourquoi les utilisez-vous si rarement ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite l'usage des transports en commun selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: L'arrêt est trop loin ou difficile à rejoindre
fr.#Services are infrequent or unreliable: Les passages sont peu fréquents ou peu fiables
fr.#Poor service in the evening or at night: Le service est insuffisant le soir ou la nuit
fr.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Les arrêts ou les véhicules ne sont pas accessibles en fauteuil roulant, avec un déambulateur ou une poussette
fr.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité aux arrêts ou à bord
fr.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Les trajets sont trop longs ou demandent trop de correspondances
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux

de.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Warum nutzen Sie öffentliche Verkehrsmittel nicht oder so selten? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was die Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: Die Haltestelle ist zu weit entfernt oder schwer zu erreichen
de.#Services are infrequent or unreliable: Die Verbindungen sind selten oder unzuverlässig
de.#Poor service in the evening or at night: Schlechtes Angebot am Abend oder in der Nacht
de.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Haltestellen oder Fahrzeuge sind mit Rollstuhl, Rollator oder Kinderwagen nicht zugänglich
de.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Ich fühle mich an Haltestellen oder im Fahrzeug nicht sicher
de.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Die Fahrten dauern zu lange oder erfordern zu viele Umstiege
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir

tr.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Toplu taşımayı neden kullanmıyorsunuz ya da neden bu kadar az kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Bunu, farklı kişiler için toplu taşıma kullanımını neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: Durak çok uzak veya ulaşması zor
tr.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Duraklar veya araçlar tekerlekli sandalye, yürüteç ya da bebek arabasıyla erişilebilir değil
tr.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Duraklarda veya araçta kendimi güvende hissetmiyorum
tr.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Yolculuklar çok uzun sürüyor veya çok fazla aktarma gerektiriyor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun

fa.#Why don't you use public transport, or: چرا از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده نمی‌کنید یا چرا این‌قدر کم از آن استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits t: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: ایستگاه خیلی دور است یا رسیدن به آن دشوار است
fa.#Poor service in the evening or at night: سرویس در عصر یا شب ضعیف است
fa.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: ایستگاه‌ها یا وسایل نقلیه با ویلچر، واکر یا کالسکهٔ کودک قابل دسترسی نیستند
fa.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: در ایستگاه‌ها یا داخل وسیلهٔ نقلیه احساس امنیت نمی‌کنم
fa.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: سفرها خیلی طول می‌کشند یا تعویض‌های زیادی لازم دارند
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند

hu.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Miért nem használja a tömegközlekedést, vagy miért használja ilyen ritkán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza a tömegközlekedés használatát a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: A megálló túl messze van, vagy nehéz megközelíteni
hu.#Poor service in the evening or at night: Este vagy éjszaka gyenge a szolgáltatás
hu.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: A megállók vagy a járművek nem akadálymentesek kerekesszékkel, járókerettel vagy babakocsival
hu.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Nem érzem magam biztonságban a megállókban vagy a járműveken
hu.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Az utak túl sokáig tartanak, vagy túl sok átszállást igényelnek
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem

ar.#Why don't you use public transport, or: لماذا لا تستخدم وسائل النقل العام، أو لماذا تستخدمها نادرًا؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#We ask this to understand what limits t: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم ما الذي يحدّ من استخدام النقل العام لدى أشخاص مختلفين. الإجابة اختيارية، ويمكنك أيضًا اختيار عدم الإفصاح.
ar.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: المحطة بعيدة جدًا أو يصعب الوصول إليها
ar.#Poor service in the evening or at night: الخدمة ضعيفة في المساء أو الليل
ar.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: المحطات أو المركبات غير مهيأة للكراسي المتحركة أو المشّايات أو عربات الأطفال
ar.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: لا أشعر بالأمان في المحطات أو على متن المركبات
ar.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: الرحلات تستغرق وقتًا طويلًا أو تتطلب تبديلات كثيرة
ar.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: لا أحتاج إلى ذلك: وسائل تنقّل أخرى تناسبني أكثر
